name: musica-platform
description: Musica Social Audio & Screen Sharing Platform (Zero-DB Architecture)

scripts.dev: concurrently -n SERVER,CLIENT -c blue,magenta "npm --prefix server run dev" "npm --prefix client run dev"
scripts.build: npm --prefix shared run build && npm --prefix client run build
scripts.build:render: npm --prefix shared run build && npm --prefix server run build
scripts.build:all: npm --prefix shared run build && npm --prefix client run build && npm --prefix server run build
